request-prompt: Make the 'Talk' and 'Edit' tabs more visually prominent at the top of the page, perhaps by styling them as solid buttons instead of quiet text links.
goal: I love community-driven platforms and always seek out the talk pages, revision histories, and contribution guidelines to participate in the community process.
jobs: I want to browse a compilation of Wikipedia's highest-quality articles from May 2026 to find interesting topics to read about.
I want to find out which article was featured on Wikipedia on a specific day in May 2026.
I want to read a quick summary of a featured article from May 2026 to decide if I want to click through to the full piece.
I want to navigate to the featured article archives of other months or years to explore older curated content.
I want to access tools to nominate, review, or edit featured articles to help contribute to Wikipedia's editorial process.
I want to jump to a random featured article to learn about something unexpected.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer discovering content through curated daily highlights, featured lists, and editors' picks rather than searching for specific terms.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer directly searching for what I need and rarely pay attention to featured homepages, daily articles, or editorial lists.

preference-pairs.a: I only read articles for information and entertainment, and I have no interest in participating in the behind-the-scenes editing, curation, or talk page discussions of content websites.
preference-pairs.b: I love community-driven platforms and always seek out the talk pages, revision histories, and contribution guidelines to participate in the community process.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer highly detailed, text-heavy directory pages with multiple links and historical archives so I can explore a vast web of related information at once.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer clean, distraction-free interfaces that focus on a single piece of content at a time without extraneous navigation sidebars, archives, or metadata.

preference: I love community-driven platforms and always seek out the talk pages, revision histories, and contribution guidelines to participate in the community process.
